name: Prestige Estates Projects Limited

profile.summary: Prestige Estates Projects Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development and related activities in India. It develops residential projects, such as apartments, villas, integrated townships, and plotted developments. The company is also involved in the development of commercial properties, including office parks, corporate campuses, built-to-suit developments, business parks, and warehousing assets; shopping, dining, entertainment and culture destinations; and luxury hotels, resorts, convention centers, serviced residences and golf resorts.
